## Highlights

- Fixed a broad set of browser and TIDAL playback handoff bugs so TideReader tracks the active source more reliably
- Improved idle-state correctness so stale browser or generic TIDAL states no longer masquerade as active playback
- Added stronger diagnostics for Windows media sessions, window-title fallback, and Core Audio session visibility
- Hardened browser debug logging so normal diagnostics redact sensitive local identifiers unless deep diagnostics are explicitly enabled

## Playback detection fixes

- Fixed `Prefer TIDAL over browser playback` so TIDAL actually wins in the handoff scenarios it is meant to cover
- Fixed cases where browser playback stayed selected after TIDAL started, or blocked fallback back to browser after TIDAL stopped
- Fixed stale browser sessions and old browser metadata timestamps causing active browser playback to be ignored or stick around too long
- Added a TIDAL window-title fallback path for cases where Windows media-session data does not surface a TIDAL session
- Fixed the `browser -> not_running -> TIDAL` transition gap when browser stops and TIDAL briefly exposes only a generic title
- Fixed brief TIDAL title wobble/dropout causing the current TIDAL track to disappear while playback continued
- Reduced browser stop/pause linger so old browser playback clears faster instead of hanging for the full cooldown window

## Idle state and overlay fixes

- Fixed idle generic `TIDAL` titles appearing as active playback when nothing is actually playing
- Fixed overlay and app idle behavior so fake sample song metadata is no longer shown in not-playing states
- Fixed not-playing transitions so the app returns to a clean idle state more consistently after browser or TIDAL playback stops

## Diagnostics and privacy

- Added raw Windows media-session, window-title, Core Audio endpoint, and Core Audio session diagnostics to support troubleshooting difficult playback cases
- Added a separate `Deep diagnostic logging` mode so normal browser debug logging hashes or redacts sensitive local identifiers by default

## Notes

- This release is focused on correctness and stability rather than new end-user features
- Automated coverage remains above the repo quality gates after the added detection and logging work
